entry.summary: Every developer has been there. You're building a feature, the user clicks "delete," and you pause. Should this record actually disappear from the database, or should you just mark it as deleted? You're marking a record with a deleted_at timestamp or an is_deleted flag, then hiding it from normal queries. The data stays in your database, living its best ghost life.
